description: wakeshift (PyPI): define the events an MCP server offers, serve them as MCP Events, and emit them; Wakeshift wakes every subscribed agent conversation (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT and others). For the official MCP Python SDK (MCPServer or the low-level Server) and FastMCP 4.
rules: Read the app key from the WAKESHIFT_KEY environment variable. Never hard-code it or commit it.
Define every event with wake.define_event before calling wake.attach.
Register tools that subscribe the calling conversation with @attached.tool(subscribes=[...]), naming the events they subscribe to.
wakeshift_wait is off by default. Turn it on with wake.attach(server, tools={"wait": {"enabled": True}}) only where a request may stay open 30 seconds or more.
For FastMCP, install wakeshift[fastmcp] and use FastMCP 4: FastMCP 2.x and 3.x are built on mcp 1.x and aren't supported.
Write event descriptions as plain statements of what happened, not instructions to the agent.
